parameters.mass_basis: v3a functional design mass; assumed scenario, not measured specimen or resin mass
parameters.negative_alpha_rule: odd symmetry of positive per-fin CL, explicitly assumed
parameters.aero_basis: Reuse exact v3a computed VLM per-fin CL at0/4/8deg, linear interpolation; quasi-steady independent fins and assumed CD0+CL^2/(pi*e*AR); forces applied at actual quad-area centroids. No fitted stall extrapolation.

assumptions: Reduced quasisteady VLM-derived forces; no CFD, underwater propulsion, neural calibration, body/fin collision or wake coupling; assumed mass/CG/inertia/drag/control
